svg.title: Selected projects
svg.desc: Banshee: Offline security analysis & evidence bundles; AsphDex: Static PE / ELF malware triage; FhniX: Explainable phishing email triage; The-Trackher: Digital footprint & own-account OSINT; sentinel-security: Linux MACB timeline forensic scanner; flowscope: Offline PCAP / PCAPNG traffic analyzer
svg.text: Six local-first security tools built for analysis, triage, and forensics.
Decode artifacts, inspect PE/ELF, preserve findings.
Strings, entropy, YARA & IOC extraction — no execution.
Desktop GUI, folder reports, IMAP scans & local ML.
Inspect exposed data and reduce privacy surface.
Live filesystem & TSK disk image artifact timelines.
DNS, HTTP, TLS fingerprints, scan & beacon heuristics.
